versions.changelog:
DinzeeAgent 1.0.3

- Major update: switches to a pure "gateway+bundled skills" agent—removes direct business skill workflow logic; now only syncs and executes official Dinzee skills locally.
- Adds comprehensive references for key data sources and skill workflows.
- Updates environment variable and persistent path conventions (now uses DINZEE_USER_TOKEN, DINZEE_CREDENTIALS_PATH, DINZEE_DATA_DIR).
- CLI commands improved: result saving, directory permissions, and token management clarified.
- Removed hardcoded server skill workflow and all legacy skill manifest code.
- Documentation fully revised to reflect agent’s new sync-and-trigger local skill execution model.

dinzee-agent 1.0.1

- Added support for skill registry and installation: now includes scripts for business skill package management (`server-skills/index.json`, `dinzee_wrapper.py`).
- Updated documentation to clarify billing flows: skill install/update is free, billing happens only at data call/finalization; Sellersprite and similar sources use user’s own credentials and bypass gateway billing.
- Improved separation between local skill execution and Dinzee Gateway data calls.
- Added example scripts for integrating new business skills and Amazon Alexa search.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file as the entry point is now fully described in updated documentation.

- Initial release of DinzeeAgent: a cross-border e-commerce data agent for Amazon sellers.
- Supports dynamic discovery of all available data sources and tools at runtime via the Dinzee gateway.
- Users can trigger research tasks using @<source> (e.g. @sif) to orchestrate MCP tools for ASIN/keyword/traffic/ad analytics.
- Unified authentication and per-call billing managed via the gateway; upstream endpoints are never exposed.
- Skill installation and upgrades are handled via point-based billing, with transparent skill listing and pricing.
- All tool names, data sources, and capabilities are dynamically fetched—nothing is hardcoded, ensuring up-to-date access to new features.
